title: Teaching himself clarinet and leaving for New Orleans in 1918
summary: He taught himself drums and clarinet, got tips from barber Piku Lazana, and left with Tom Albert in 1918.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Wait, let me, before we get into the, when you played clarinet, did you have any lessons on drums? No. You just picked it up? Just picked it up. Yeah. Where did you get hold of your first hand? Was it a proper drum ampute or it might not? Yeah, no, no, I had a set of leaders.

Some of the best made, yeah. How long were you playing drums for? Well, I played drums about three, four years. Then I played a little bass, I played a little guitar, I played a little man on it. And I used to strike a couple of tunes on the piano.

But I never was interested in nothing like none of them. I wanted to blow. I got me a clarinet. I was a clarinet. And nobody learned me nothing about that. I just found all the cards. I mean all the new things I wanted to find myself. But my daddy didn't know nothing about it. And nobody around here. There was a fellow around here named Piku. White from the barber here. Here, after I began to practice and clearly, he called me up to his barber shop and he showed me a whole lot of this, you know, tech things on the home. And then I used to go back here on this bridge back here. And they had gang of people around me. I was sitting there blowing on them by myself. And, uh, one time, my daddy sent Tom Albert to come over here and play trumpet for him. And we had got to sit in here and have a trumpet player. And Tom come over here and play several dates with him. And one day he come over here and play. I was playing clarinet. And he asked my daddy to let me go to New Orleans and play some dates with him. And he consented and I left here in 1918. And he was talking about 피Cu. We mentioned some things back then. Yeah. We didn't get 피Cu's full name.
His name was 피Cu Lazana. 피Cu Lazana. 피Cu Lazana. Yeah. He was a barber here.
Italian tarot. Yeah. Yeah. He was.
